## 目标

from_raw_parts / from_raw_parts_mut with storage_len and validate_access_range。
本任务将 SUMMARY.md 中的目标落实到 `src/tensor/construct.rs`，并与 `07-tensor §5, §6, §7, §8` 的 API、实现拆分和测试计划保持一致。

## 前置准备

- 确认 W6T5 已提供 layout flags 与 F-order stride 计算。
- 确认 W7 存储模块已提供 Owned/View/ViewMut/Arc 表示和 storage trait。
- 按 `07-tensor.md §5` 保持 tensor core 的最小职责。

## 实施步骤

### Step 1: 实现核心代码

在 `src/tensor/construct.rs` 中添加本任务要求的最小实现，保持职责边界与设计文档一致。

```rust
impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    D: crate::dimension::Dimension,
{
    /// Internal unchecked constructor.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    ///
    /// Caller must guarantee:
    /// - `offset + (shape[i]-1)*|strides[i]| < storage.len()` for all non-empty tensors
    /// - `derived_from_view_mut` is `true` only when this tensor is a `ViewRepr` demoted from a `ViewMutRepr`
    pub(crate) unsafe fn new_unchecked(storage: S, shape: D, strides: crate::layout::Strides<D>, offset: usize, flags: crate::layout::LayoutFlags, derived_from_view_mut: bool) -> Self {
        Self { storage, shape, strides, offset, flags, derived_from_view_mut }
    }
}

impl<A, D> TensorBase<crate::storage::ViewRepr<'_, A>, D>
where
    D: crate::dimension::Dimension,
{
    /// Construct a read-only view tensor from raw parts with validation.
    pub fn from_raw_parts(storage: crate::storage::ViewRepr<'_, A>, shape: D, strides: crate::layout::Strides<D>, offset: usize, flags: crate::layout::LayoutFlags) -> crate::Result<Self> {
        validate_access_range(&shape, &strides, offset, storage.len())?;
        Ok(unsafe { Self::new_unchecked(storage, shape, strides, offset, flags, false) })
    }
}

impl<A, D> TensorBase<crate::storage::ViewMutRepr<'_, A>, D>
where
    D: crate::dimension::Dimension,
{
    /// Construct a mutable view tensor from raw parts with validation.
    pub fn from_raw_parts_mut(storage: crate::storage::ViewMutRepr<'_, A>, shape: D, strides: crate::layout::Strides<D>, offset: usize, flags: crate::layout::LayoutFlags) -> crate::Result<Self> {
        validate_access_range(&shape, &strides, offset, storage.len())?;
        Ok(unsafe { Self::new_unchecked(storage, shape, strides, offset, flags, false) })
    }
}

impl<A, D> TensorBase<crate::storage::ArcRepr<A>, D>
where
    D: crate::dimension::Dimension,
{
    /// Construct an Arc-backed tensor from raw parts with validation.
    pub fn from_raw_parts(storage: crate::storage::ArcRepr<A>, shape: D, strides: crate::layout::Strides<D>, offset: usize, flags: crate::layout::LayoutFlags) -> crate::Result<Self> {
        validate_access_range(&shape, &strides, offset, storage.len())?;
        Ok(unsafe { Self::new_unchecked(storage, shape, strides, offset, flags, false) })
    }
}

fn validate_access_range<D>(shape: &D, strides: &crate::layout::Strides<D>, offset: usize, storage_len: usize) -> crate::Result<()>
where
    D: crate::dimension::Dimension,
{
    let len = shape.checked_size().ok_or_else(|| XenonError::invalid_shape("tensor size overflow"))?;
    if len == 0 {
        return (offset <= storage_len).then_some(()).ok_or_else(|| XenonError::invalid_layout("offset out of range"));
    }
    let max_delta = shape.slice().iter().zip(strides.slice()).try_fold(0usize, |acc, (&dim, &stride)| {
        let step = dim.saturating_sub(1);
        let delta = stride.unsigned_abs().checked_mul(step)?;
        acc.checked_add(delta)
    }).ok_or_else(|| XenonError::invalid_layout("access range overflow"))?;
    offset.checked_add(max_delta).filter(|&last| last < storage_len).map(|_| ()).ok_or_else(|| XenonError::invalid_layout("access range out of bounds"))
}
```

### Step 2: 单元测试

> **强制要求**:
> - 本步骤必须包含一个或者多个单元测试。
> - 测试函数名称和测试内容必须参考对应设计文档的 **「测试计划」** 一节。
> - 编译检查与Lint检查不等同于单元测试。
> - 如果测试没有通过需要修复直至测试通过。
> - **无测试 = 任务未完成。**

测试依据: 覆盖 `validate_access_range` 错误路径及 ViewRepr/ViewMutRepr/ArcRepr 三种 `from_raw_parts` 构造路径。

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::validate_access_range;
    use crate::layout::{LayoutFlags, Strides};
    use crate::storage::{ArcRepr, ViewMutRepr, ViewRepr};

    #[test]
    fn test_validate_access_range_out_of_bounds() {
        let result = validate_access_range(&[2, 2], &Strides::from([1, 2]), 0, 3);
        assert!(result.is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_validate_access_range_valid() {
        assert!(validate_access_range(&[2, 2], &Strides::from([1, 2]), 0, 4).is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_from_raw_parts_view_valid() {
        let data = vec![1_i32, 2, 3, 4];
        let storage = unsafe { ViewRepr::from_raw_parts(data.as_ptr(), data.len()) };
        let tensor: TensorBase<ViewRepr<'_, i32>, _> =
            TensorBase::from_raw_parts(storage, [2, 2], Strides::from([1, 2]), 0, LayoutFlags::F_CONTIGUOUS)
                .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(tensor.len(), 4);
        assert_eq!(tensor.shape(), &[2, 2]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_from_raw_parts_mut_valid() {
        let mut data = vec![1_i32, 2, 3, 4];
        let storage = unsafe { ViewMutRepr::from_raw_parts_mut(data.as_mut_ptr(), data.len()) };
        let tensor: TensorBase<ViewMutRepr<'_, i32>, _> =
            TensorBase::from_raw_parts_mut(storage, [2, 2], Strides::from([1, 2]), 0, LayoutFlags::F_CONTIGUOUS)
                .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(tensor.len(), 4);
        assert_eq!(tensor.shape(), &[2, 2]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_from_raw_parts_arc_valid() {
        let data = vec![1_i32, 2, 3, 4];
        let storage = crate::storage::ArcRepr::from_vec(data);
        let tensor: TensorBase<ArcRepr<i32>, _> =
            TensorBase::from_raw_parts(storage, [2, 2], Strides::from([1, 2]), 0, LayoutFlags::F_CONTIGUOUS)
                .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(tensor.len(), 4);
        assert_eq!(tensor.shape(), &[2, 2]);
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| `new_unchecked` 作为 `pub(crate)` 内部不安全构造器 | `07-tensor.md §5.6`：将所有 unsafe 构造逻辑集中到单入口，便于审计 |
| `from_raw_parts` / `from_raw_parts_mut` 通过 `validate_access_range` 验证 | `07-tensor.md §5.6`：公共 API 必须拒绝非法 shape/strides/offset 组合 |
| 三个存储变体（ViewRepr/ViewMutRepr/ArcRepr）分别提供 `from_raw_parts` | `07-tensor.md §6`：每个存储类型的构造签名与 Rust 借用规则对齐 |
| Arc 路径 `derived_from_view_mut` 始终为 `false` | Arc 从不降级 ViewMutRepr，不存在 `ViewMut → Arc` 转换路径 |

## 注意事项

- `validate_access_range` 对零长度 tensor 仅检查 `offset <= storage_len`，不检查 strides。
- `try_fold`/`checked_mul` 保护整数溢出 → 恶意 shape/strides 组合不会 UB。
- `from_raw_parts_mut` 要求输入 `ViewMutRepr`，不可变 `ViewRepr` 不能用此入口。
